_provenance.what: Independent RAW (as-traded, unadjusted) daily closes from Polygon, for the split-basis repair tool's raw-print checks (python -m pipeline.repair_split_basis --spot-file ...). Each value is the 'c' (close) and 'v' (volume) of the named ticker's row in Polygon's v2 grouped-daily aggregates with adjusted=false, copied verbatim (no rounding, no rescaling).
